GeoFlip project-page notices

OSWorld 2.0
Website: https://osworld-v2.xlang.ai/
The hero, author/affiliation list, resource buttons, headline statistics, and
section-heading HTML are reused with GeoFlip research content substituted.
The following stylesheets are copied without modification from that website:
  static/css/index.css -> osworld-base.css
  stylesheets/index.css -> osworld-layout.css
  static/css/osworld-official-match.css -> osworld-official-match.css
GeoFlip-specific video and table adaptations are in styles.css and app.js.
No OSWorld research content, branding, media, scripts, or remote fonts are used.
No separate website-specific license was found in the downloaded HTML/CSS.
No new license is asserted for the OSWorld files.
